tools.name: kiwihr_list_users
tools.description: List or search employees (kiwiHR 'users') with name, work email, active flag, employee number, employment dates, position, team, location and manager. Filter by active state, team, location, position, e-mail or name. Payroll, bank, tax and insurance data are never included. GraphQL query users.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_user
tools.description: One employee by id: the list fields plus probation end, about-me, language, invitation status, work phones, all teams, work schedule and custom field values. With include_personal=true it also returns birth date, private e-mail and phone, nationality, gender, pronouns, home address, emergency contac

tools.name: kiwihr_list_teams
tools.description: List teams and departments (id, name, kind GROUP or DEPARTMENT). Use the ids to filter employees. GraphQL query teams.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_locations
tools.description: List office locations (id, name). Use the ids to filter employees. GraphQL query locations.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_positions
tools.description: List job positions (id, name). Use the ids to filter employees. GraphQL query positions.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the company's custom employee profile fields (id, name, section, data type, choice options). Payroll and bank sections are listed by name only; their values are never returned by any tool. GraphQL query customFields.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_time_off_types
tools.description: List time off (absence) types such as vacation or sick leave: id, name, colour, visibility to team members. Use the ids with kiwihr_get_time_off_usage and kiwihr_list_time_off_balances. GraphQL query timeOffTypes.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_time_off_balances
tools.description: Time off balances of all employees: per employee and time off rule the allowance, accrued, used, requested, planned and available days, carry-over and the accrual/usage periods. Filter by time off type, active state and usage period. The API has no per-employee filter or paging for this query; read

tools.name: kiwihr_get_time_off_usage
tools.description: Who took (or requested) how much time off in a date range: per employee the request count and used days for each time off rule of the chosen time off types. Use it for absence reports ('who was off in March?'). Optional employee filters as in kiwihr_list_users. GraphQL query timeOffRequestUsageState

tools.name: kiwihr_list_timesheets
tools.description: Daily timesheets of one employee (or the key's admin user when user_id is omitted) in a date range: expected, tracked, time off, holiday and break time in SECONDS, approval flag, time offs, holidays, entries (start/end, type, note, project) and break-rule violations. GraphQL query timesheets.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_timesheet
tools.description: The timesheet of ONE employee for ONE day (user_id omitted = the admin user the key acts as), with all entries and their ids (needed to update or delete an entry). Times in seconds. GraphQL query timesheet.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_attendance_statement
tools.description: Attendance summary of ONE employee over a date range: expected, tracked, total, time off and holiday time (seconds) and days, balance, overtime, meal vouchers, and tracked time per project. GraphQL query attendanceStatement.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_attendance_statements
tools.description: Attendance summaries of ALL employees over a date range (expected vs tracked time, time off, holidays, balance, overtime, tracked time per project). Optionally only employees with time tracked on a project, or with uncategorized time; inactive employees can be included. GraphQL query attendanceState

tools.name: kiwihr_list_overtime_balances
tools.description: Current overtime balance (seconds) per employee. GraphQL query overtimeBalanceStatements.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_projects
tools.description: List time-tracking projects (id, name, status ACTIVE or INACTIVE). GraphQL query projects.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_project
tools.description: One time-tracking project by id (name, status). GraphQL query project.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_journeys
tools.description: List onboarding/offboarding journeys (id, name, status DRAFT/ONGOING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED, assignee, journey type, custom date). Filter by status, assignee, type or team. GraphQL query journeys.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_journey
tools.description: One journey by id with its steps (name, description, fixed start and due dates). With include_personal=true it also returns the private e-mail address stored on the journey. GraphQL query journey.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_journey_templates
tools.description: List journey templates (id, name, description, type). Use a template id with kiwihr_create_journey. GraphQL query journeyTemplates.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_journey_types
tools.description: List journey types such as pre-onboarding, onboarding or offboarding (id, name, key, archived date). GraphQL query journeyTypes.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_timesheet_entry
tools.description: WRITE: add a time entry to the timesheet of one employee on one day (user_id omitted = the admin user the key acts as). type MANUAL = worked time (give start_at and end_at as HH:mm:ss, or a part_of_day), BREAK = a break. Optional project and note. Creates a new entry each call (not idempotent). Retu

tools.name: kiwihr_update_timesheet_entry
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing timesheet entry (get its id from kiwihr_get_timesheet): times, part of day, project or note. Only the fields you pass are changed. Setting the same values again gives the same result. Returns the updated day. GraphQL mutation updateTimesheetEntry.

tools.name: kiwihr_delete_timesheet_entry
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete one timesheet entry by id (get it from kiwihr_get_timesheet). This cannot be undone. Returns true when deleted. GraphQL mutation deleteTimesheetEntry.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a time-tracking project (name, status ACTIVE or INACTIVE; default ACTIVE). Creates a new project each call (not idempotent). GraphQL mutation createProject.

tools.name: kiwihr_update_project
tools.description: WRITE: rename a project or switch it ACTIVE/INACTIVE (INACTIVE projects can no longer be used for time tracking). Only the fields you pass are changed. GraphQL mutation updateProject.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_user
tools.description: WRITE: add a new employee record (first name, last name and work e-mail are required; optional start date, manager, teams, position, location and phones). Creates a new employee each call (not idempotent). No invitation is sent by this tool. Payroll and bank data cannot be set. GraphQL mutation crea

tools.name: kiwihr_update_user
tools.description: WRITE: change an employee's work profile: name, start date, about-me, work phones, position, team(s), location, manager. Only the fields you pass are changed (team_ids replaces the whole team list). Private, payroll and bank data cannot be changed with this tool. GraphQL mutation updateUser.

tools.name: kiwihr_deactivate_user
tools.description: WRITE, ACCESS-CHANGING: deactivate an active employee (typically after they leave): they lose access to kiwiHR and drop out of active lists. Reversible with kiwihr_activate_user. GraphQL mutation deactivateUser.

tools.name: kiwihr_activate_user
tools.description: WRITE: re-activate a deactivated employee so they appear in active lists and can use kiwiHR again. GraphQL mutation activateUser.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_journey
tools.description: WRITE: create an onboarding/offboarding journey for an employee from a journey type and optionally a template (ids from kiwihr_list_journey_types / kiwihr_list_journey_templates). Creates a new journey each call (not idempotent). It does not publish it; check the status in the reply. GraphQL mutatio

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kiwihr_list_users · Private data: kiwihr_get_user, kiwihr_get_journey, kiwihr_create_user, kiwihr_update_user · Public sink: kiwihr_list_users, kiwihr_create_journey · Destructive: kiwihr_get_timesheet, kiwihr_delete_timesheet_entry, kiwihr_deactivate_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kiwihr_list_users · Private data: kiwihr_get_user, kiwihr_get_journey, kiwihr_create_user, kiwihr_update_user · Public sink: kiwihr_list_users, kiwihr_create_journey · Destructive: kiwihr_get_timesheet, kiwihr_delete_timesheet_entry, kiwihr_deactivate_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
